column2: Verify successful booking creation by Pet Owner (Mobile)
column3:
1. Login to Mobile App as PET_OWNER.
2. Navigate to Clinic Detail.
3. Tap 'Đặt lịch'.
4. Select valid Date (tomorrow), Time slot, Pet, and Service.
5. Tap 'Xác nhận'.
column4:
Booking is created.
Toast message: 'Đặt lịch thành công'. Redirected to Home/History.

column2: Verify booking validation when no Pet is selected
column3:
1. Select Date, Time, Service.
2. Deselect/leave Pet empty.
3. Tap 'Xác nhận'.
column4:
Submission blocked.
Validation message: 'Vui lòng chọn thú cưng'.

column2: Verify booking validation when selecting a past date/time
column3:
1. Attempt to select a date in the past.
2. Tap 'Xác nhận'.
column4:
The UI prevents selecting past dates (greyed out).
Error if bypassed: 'Thời gian đã qua không hợp lệ'.

column2: Verify booking validation on an already fully booked timeslot
column3:
1. Select a timeslot known to be at maximum capacity.
2. Tap 'Xác nhận'.
column4:
The timeslot is greyed out.
Error if bypassed: 'Khung giờ này đã kín lịch'.

column2: Verify booking creation triggers notification to Manager/Staff
column3:
1. Create a successful booking.
2. Wait for system notification.
column4: Manager/Staff receives a realtime notification: 'Có một lịch hẹn mới đang chờ xác nhận'.

column2: Verify successful Staff booking on behalf for existing Pet Owner
column3:
1. Login to Web as STAFF.
2. Go to 'Tạo lịch hẹn'.
3. Search existing Pet Owner and their Pet.
4. Select Service, Date, Time.
5. Click 'Tạo lịch'.
column4:
Booking created successfully.
Toast message: 'Tạo lịch hẹn thành công'.

column2: Verify Staff booking on behalf for a completely new Pet Owner
column3:
1. Login as STAFF.
2. Click 'Thêm chủ thú cưng mới' in the dialog.
3. Enter new Phone, Name, Pet details.
4. Complete booking details.
5. Click 'Tạo lịch'.
column4:
New User and Pet are created, then Booking is created.
Toast message: 'Tạo lịch hẹn thành công'.

column2: Verify Staff booking validation (missing mandatory fields)
column3:
1. Leave Customer Info or Pet Name empty.
2. Click 'Tạo lịch'.
column4:
Submission blocked.
Red text under fields: 'Vui lòng nhập họ tên chủ'.

column2: Verify viewing all details of an appointment
column3:
1. Open the booking list.
2. Click on a specific appointment record.
column4: Full details modal displays Pet info, Owner info, Service chosen, Add-ons, Time, Status.

column2: Verify viewing appointment details of a CANCELLED booking
column3:
1. Filter list to CANCELLED.
2. Click on a record.
column4: Details show 'Lý do hủy' (Cancellation reason) and the user who cancelled.

column2: Verify Pet Owner viewing 'Chờ xác nhận' appointments
column3:
1. Login Mobile App.
2. Go to 'Lịch hẹn của tôi'.
3. Select 'Chờ xác nhận' tab.
column4: List displays only PENDING bookings sorted chronologically.

column2: Verify Pet Owner viewing 'Đã hoàn thành' appointments
column3: 1. Select 'Đã hoàn thành' tab.
column4: List displays COMPLETED bookings. Option to 'Đánh giá' (Rate) appears.

column2: Verify empty state display when no appointments exist
column3: 1. Go to 'Lịch hẹn của tôi' on a new account.
column4: A user-friendly empty state illustration and text 'Bạn chưa có lịch hẹn nào'.

column2: Verify successful rescheduling a PENDING booking by Staff
column3:
1. Open a PENDING booking on Web.
2. Click 'Đổi lịch'.
3. Pick a new valid Date/Time slot.
4. Confirm changes.
column4:
Booking time is updated.
Toast message: 'Đổi lịch thành công'.

column2: Verify rescheduling a booking to an unavailable timeslot
column3:
1. Click 'Đổi lịch'.
2. Select a fully booked slot.
3. Confirm.
column4:
Action blocked.
Toast message: 'Khung giờ này đã kín lịch'.

column2: Verify updating booking note by Staff
column3:
1. Open a booking.
2. Edit 'Ghi chú' field.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Note is updated.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật thành công'.

column2: Verify changing primary Service of an active booking
column3:
1. Open a booking.
2. Change the main Service selected.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Service is updated, Total Price is recalculated.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật thành công'.

column2: Verify successful cancellation of a PENDING booking by Pet Owner
column3:
1. Open a PENDING booking on Mobile.
2. Click 'Hủy lịch hẹn' and select reason.
3. Confirm.
column4:
Status changes to CANCELLED.
Toast message: 'Đã hủy lịch hẹn'.

column2: Verify cancellation of a CONFIRMED booking by Pet Owner (Check Policy)
column3:
1. Attempt to cancel a CONFIRMED booking starting in less than 2 hours.
2. Confirm cancellation.
column4: System might show a warning popup about cancellation policy/fee, depending on business rules.

column2: Verify successful cancellation by Clinic Manager
column3:
1. Login as CLINIC_MANAGER.
2. Open a PENDING/CONFIRMED booking.
3. Click 'Từ chối/Hủy' button and enter a reason.
4. Confirm.
column4:
Status changes to CANCELLED. Notification sent to Pet Owner.
Toast message: 'Đã hủy lịch hẹn'.

column2: Verify reassigning a different active staff to a booking
column3:
1. Open a CONFIRMED booking assigned to Staff A.
2. Select Staff B from dropdown.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Staff B is now assigned.
Toast message: 'Gán nhân viên rảnh thành công'.

column2: Verify reassigning to a staff already busy at that time
column3:
1. Select Staff C who has an overlapping active shift/booking.
2. Save changes.
column4: System displays warning or blocks action if strict rule applies. (Expected: 'Nhân viên này đang bận ca').

column2: Verify successfully assigning staff to an unassigned booking
column3:
1. Open an unassigned CONFIRMED booking.
2. Select a valid staff member.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Staff is assigned.
Toast message: 'Gán nhân viên thành công'.

column2: Verify updating status from PENDING to CONFIRMED
column3:
1. Open a PENDING booking.
2. Click 'Xác nhận'.
column4:
Status changes to CONFIRMED.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật trạng thái thành công'.

column2: Verify updating status from CONFIRMED to IN_PROGRESS
column3:
1. Open a CONFIRMED booking.
2. Click 'Bắt đầu khám' (Start).
column4:
Status changes to IN_PROGRESS.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật trạng thái thành công'.

column2: Verify updating status from IN_PROGRESS to COMPLETED
column3:
1. Open an IN_PROGRESS booking.
2. Click 'Hoàn thành' (Complete).
column4:
Status changes to COMPLETED.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật trạng thái thành công'.

column2: Verify invalid status transition bypass attempt
column3: 1. Attempt to jump from PENDING directly to COMPLETED via API.
column4:
API returns error status 400.
Backend invalidation prevents bypass.

column2: Verify successfully adding an Add-on Service
column3:
1. Open an active booking.
2. Select an extra 'Phụ phí/Dịch vụ phụ'.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Add-on appears in the summary list. Total Price increases correctly.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật dịch vụ thành công'.

column2: Verify successfully removing an Add-on Service
column3:
1. Open a booking having an existing add-on.
2. Deselect/Remove the add-on.
3. Save changes.
column4:
Add-on is removed. Total Price decreases correctly.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật dịch vụ thành công'.

column2: Verify new bookings display on Staff Web Dashboard
column3:
1. Pet Owner creates a new booking.
2. Logged in Staff views 'Lịch hẹn mới' / 'Chờ xác nhận'.
column4: The new booking appears without requiring a full page refresh (if WebSocket/Polling applies), otherwise it appears on refresh.
